title: Never Tick Alone
description: Suspend server ticks when no players logged in
body:
_Never Tick Alone is a_ server-side-only mod to suspend the world from updating when no players are online.

 

Useful for servers that don't want players to have automated resource gathering when not present,

or just for saving a few CPU cycles.

 

Only supports dedicated servers.

When no players are connected to a server, it will stop ticking the World entirely, and reduce the Server Thread to 3 TPS.
